storeId.description: Durable store that released the resource.

sha256.description: Content hash in algo:hex form, e.g. "sha256:abcd...".

releasedAt.description: The first release; a repeat answers the same instant.

ControlResourceRelease.description: Receipt of a released managed resource. Not a deletion: bytes stay while accepted commands, turns or drafts hold them or another live resource shares the digest.
